items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Susan and Ralph... Mose’s cousin Susan married Ralph, who was his really best friend...

ctx.x: Yes, I recorded that. That’s a beautiful song. Then there’s a lot... Like, “Numbers On Paper” is a beautiful one. I’d have to look to see.
Georgie Fame did “Was.” He said the first time he heard it, it made him cry. Susan and Ralph... Mose’s cousin Susan married Ralph, who was his really best friend...
“Ever Since I Stole The Blues” is funny. “Ever Since the World Ended”...
